questions.stem: A 35-year-old individual met with a Road traffic accident, Local’s brought him to ER, he was confused and had significant heavy blood loss. Which of the following is a sign of hemorrhagic shock?
questions.solutionHtml:
Low hematocrit

The patient presented with hemorrhagic shock, loss of blood causes blood pressure to fall and Heart rate to increase.




Ganong's Review of Medical Physiology, 26th Edition, Page No.604-609.

questions.stem: A 72-year-old woman presents to her physician with dyspnea. Pulmonary function tests revealed an increase, rather than a decrease, in the diffusing capacity of the lung. Which of the following conditions best accounts for an increase in the diffusing capacity?
questions.solutionHtml:
Polycythemia

Increases in the diffusing capacity can be produced by increasing the concentration of hemoglobin within the blood (polycythemia).




Ganong's Review of Medical Physiology, 26th Edition, Page No.660-661.

questions.stem: A Young individual male lost consciousness in a car with a running engine where he had been waiting for a friend for a long time. What hemoglobin compound can be found in the blood of the patient?
questions.solutionHtml:
Carboxyhemoglobin

Car fumes contain carbon monoxide.




Guyton and Hall, Textbook of Medical Physiology, 14th Edition, Page Number:445.

questions.stem: Which type of hemoglobin is not normally found within human erythrocytes?
questions.solutionHtml:
HbCO

HbCO hemoglobin is not normally found within human erythrocytes.




Ganong's Review of Medical Physiology, 26th Edition, Page Number: 523.
